subject: [PATCH v3 06/12] nfsd: pin the client while a GETATTR holds a conflicting delegation

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug where a client could be destroyed while waiting for a GETATTR reply, causing the server to access a freed client. To prevent this, it introduces two new functions: nfsd4_get_leased_deleg and nfsd4_put_leased_deleg. These functions take a reference on both the delegation and the client while holding the flc_lock, ensuring that the client remains alive until the lease is released. This approach addresses the issue of conflicting delegations during GETATTR operations.
